purpose: Moye typography profile and settings experience regression, not original-app parity

results.name: built-in profile changes real typography as one durable display operation and preserves CRLF document
each typography field restores the selected profile baseline instead of global defaults
draft sample previews immediately and before/current comparison does not revert durable settings
current settings can be saved as a named profile and duplicate names fail without partial changes
copy and confirmed delete manage profiles while preserving current typography
search keeps unrelated results focused and profile cards can be found by typography words
settings input composition is not saved mid-composition and closes only after committed text
profile operations retain disabled formula controls for the selected engine
profiles persist across an actual application restart
compact settings remain usable with profile controls and comparison on a narrow viewport
